visual_qa.criteria: No readable/fake text, numbers, clock/calendar/planner grid, UI, logos, people, distorted objects, or unsafe details.

generation.prompt: Photorealistic editorial still life illustrating short focus intervals versus larger protected work blocks: a realistic clear glass hourglass on a warm neutral wood desk, beside six plain solid-color wooden rectangular blocks arranged as three small intervals and three larger project blocks, one fully closed plain linen notebook with no markings. No paper, no cards, no open notebook, no planner, no grid, no clock, no watch, no calendar, no numbers, no letters, no handwriting, no printed text, no screen, no device, no logos, no brand marks, no UI. Natural soft window light, physically plausible objects, clean professional blog photography, wide composition.
